hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was ramped from fully off to on starting at 13:37 (partial: 163 off / 37 on) and fully on by 13:38. Requests served with the flag on hit a ZeroDivisionError in the account-page monthly-spend calculation, driving the error rate from ~1% baseline to 26-40%.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero (new error class, first appears exactly at the onset minute; before 13:37 all errors were 'UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out')
error_rate 0.01 at 13:36 -> 0.06 at 13:37 -> 0.31 at 13:38, with request_volume flat at 1200 and p50/p95 latency unchanged
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-11T13:37:00Z to 2026-09-12T13:37:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: an unrecorded code rollout introduced the division-by-zero path, and the flag log lines merely reflect the new build's evaluations. Nothing in the change record supports this - the 24h change lookback is empty - so it is a distant second.
